title: Syrian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Syrian dish made with chicken cooked in a flavorful tagine sauce with a hint of jawshan, served with a side of crusty bread.
instructions: Heat butter in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add jawshan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add tagine sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot over crusty bread or with steamed vegetables.
